Name: Gifts from Clint
Author: LoganDoidao989
Description:
[center][color=#AAAAAA][size=4][b]⛏️ Gifts from Clint – Forged Through Friendship[/b][/size][/color][/center]
[center][color=#AAAAAA]
Ever wondered what happens when Pelican Town’s blacksmith finally decides to show appreciation with something other than awkward silence and furnace noises? 🔥😅
As your friendship with Clint grows, he’ll start sending useful mining supplies, geodes, ores, cooked meals, and even powerful equipment straight to your mailbox! 📬⛏️💎
From a humble pile of stone and quartz 🪨✨ to rare iridium ore and legendary mining rewards 💜⚒️, Clint slowly opens up through handcrafted gifts forged with sweat, metal, and probably a concerning amount of coal dust. ⚫😂[/color]

[line]
[heading][color=#AAAAAA]✨ Features[/color][/heading]
[color=#AAAAAA]✅ Progressive friendship rewards from 1 to 10 hearts ❤️
✅ Balanced mining-themed gifts ⛏️
✅ Sequential mail progression system 📬
✅ Fully compatible with Stardew Valley 1.6 🌾
✅ Android / SMAPI mobile friendly 📱
✅ Lightweight and lore-friendly 🌟
✅ Carefully selected rewards that grow with your journey 💎[/color][/center]
